summary: std/textproto: read_header is linear in the number of fields (40000 fields: 5.8 s to 3 ms)
details: read_header is linear in the number of fields (40000 fields: 5.8 s to 3 ms); std/mail, std/multipart and std/smtp read headers with it. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/textproto, all backends): read_header is linear in the number of fields (40000 fields: 5.8 s to 3 ms); std/mail, std/multipart and std/smtp read headers with it. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
